anya: Quick note from the hydra-v3 onboarding: after int6 quant we see preserved L2 norms but cosine similarity distributions shift slightly. Recall@5 down ~1.1% on webkb-sampled slice. Anyone tracking angle preservation when quantizing? :mag_right:

sam: angle preservation is tricky with per-tensor quant. Do you have distribution diffs (cosine histograms) between fp16 and int6?

anya: yes, attached a small summary: median cosine(fp16, int6) between corresponding embeddings ~0.995, but tail mass below 0.97 increased from 2.4% -> 5.7%. recall@1 stable, recall@5 drops. Command:

```
python compare_angles.py --model hydra-v3 --quant int6_onnx --dataset webkb-sampled --metrics recall@1,5,10,cosine_shift,angle_hist
```

ravi: tails matter for K>1 if your nearest neighbors rely on small angle differences. Two quick ideas: 1) try cosine normalization after quantization (rescale by learned scalar), 2) perform a lightweight orthonormalization / whitening using a calibration set to align int6 mean and covariance to fp16.

toni: orthogonal Procrustes is another option: solve R that best aligns int6->fp16 on calibration pairs, then apply R to int6 vectors before indexing. Cheap if dimension small.

anya: ran a tiny Procrustes on 10k calib pairs: alignment reduces tail mass below 0.97 from 5.7% -> 3.1% and rec@5 recovered ~0.6 points. Not full recovery but helps.

mike: curious if whitening (ZCA) had similar effect? It can remove axis-aligned biases.

anya: tried ZCA on calibration covariances; it reduced centroid_shift but had marginal effect on tail cosines. Procrustes seemed better for directional bias.

sam: note that Procrustes requires storing the rotation matrix; small cost. Also check that rotation preserves downstream semantics across other datasets (news vs webkb). Might overfit to cal set.

anya: validated across news-sampled and forum-sampled holdouts: Procrustes trained on webkb improves webkb and forum, slight dip on news (-0.2% rec@5). Suggest adding dataset-stratified calib.

ravi: for onboarding checklist: include 1) cosine histogram diagnostic, 2) tail-mass check, 3) try Procrustes if directional bias found, 4) fall back to int8 or fp16 for SLA tiers. Also add eval for index sensitivity (ef_search).

eval-bot: queued eval job 9991: hydra-v3 int6-proc-aligned on webkb/forum/news stratified (user=anya). Artifacts -> s3://redwood-evals/hydra/v3/1749998887/job-9991/

anya: interim: Procrustes + ef_search=200 recovered ~0.9 rec@5 vs fp16 baseline; still testing stability over 3-week rolling slices. Will post artifacts and minimal script for the onboarding repo.

toni: great. If stable, we can add a small rotation step to the embed-pipeline with configurable flag. Keep an eye on latency for the rotation step at query time — might be best applied at index-time only.

anya: applying at index-time only. Thanks all, will follow up with PR and eval artifacts.
